24702-the-ghost-breaker-a-melodramatic-f.title: The Ghost Breaker A Melodramatic Farce In Four Acts
24702-the-ghost-breaker-a-melodramatic-f.creator: Unknown
24702-the-ghost-breaker-a-melodramatic-f.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Produced in New York, and for two seasons on tour. Martha By-the-Day An optimistic comedy in 3 acts, by Julie M. Lippmann, author of the "Martha" stories. Full of quaint humor, old-fashioned, homely sentiment, the kind that people who see the play will recall and chuckle over tomorrow and the next day.

54380-a-battle-of-the-books-recorded-by-.title: A Battle Of The Books Recorded By An Unknown Writer For The
54380-a-battle-of-the-books-recorded-by-.creator: Unknown
54380-a-battle-of-the-books-recorded-by-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. the course of the narrative, I shall not dwell upon it; nor is it, indeed, a matter of importance, except as it bears upon the question of the participation in the government by both sexes. Viewed from that point, it shows with great force the inability of women to understand affairs, and the groundlessness of the present clamor for a change of status.

63799-tepondicon.title: Tepondicon
63799-tepondicon.creator: Unknown
63799-tepondicon.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Plague-ridden, feared, legendary! Like its six sister cities, the place was known throughout the System as a pest-hole, tenanted by doomed citizenry whose very futility of life made a mockery of everything decent and law-abiding.

arxiv-2102-08755.title: Formation of Social Ties Influences Food Choice: A Campus-Wide Longitudinal Study Journal: PACMHCI Volume: 5 CSCW1 184 4 Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3449297 CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in collaborative and social computing CCS: Applied computing Health informatics CCS: Information
arxiv-2102-08755.creator: Kristina Gligorić, Ryen W. White, Emre Kıcıman, Eric Horvitz, Arnaud Chiolero, Robert West
arxiv-2102-08755.description: Abstract . Nutrition is a key determinant of long-term health, and social influence has long been theorized to be a key determinant of nutrition. It has been difficult to quantify the postulated role of social influence on nutrition using traditional methods such as surveys, due to the typically small scale and short duration of studies.

arxiv-2309-10131.title: Deep Prompt Tuning for Graph Transformers
arxiv-2309-10131.creator: Reza Shirkavand, Heng Huang
arxiv-2309-10131.description: Abstract Graph transformers have gained popularity in various graph-based tasks by addressing challenges faced by traditional Graph Neural Networks. However, the quadratic complexity of self-attention operations and the extensive layering in graph transformer architectures present challenges when applying them to graph based prediction tasks. Fine-tuning, a common approach, is resource-intensive and requires storing multiple copies of large models.

arxiv-2310-05661.title: The calculus of names – the legacy of Jan Łukasiewicz Thanks: The research has been supported by the grant from the National Science Centre (NCN), Poland, project no. 2021/43/B/HS1/03187.
arxiv-2310-05661.creator: Andrzej Pietruszczak
arxiv-2310-05661.description: Abstract . With his research on Aristotle’s syllogistic, Jan Łukasiewicz 1934 ; Łukasiewicz 1939 ; Łukasiewicz 1957 ; Łukasiewicz 1963 initiates the branch of logic known as the calculus of names. This field deals with axiomatic systems that analyse various fragments of the logic of names, i.e.

arxiv-2311-01611.title: Pseudorandomness of the Schrödinger map equation
arxiv-2311-01611.creator: Sandeep Kumar
arxiv-2311-01611.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sandeep Kumar. We present the random behaviour of the Schrödinger map equation, a geometric partial differential equation, by considering its evolution for regular polygonal curves in both Euclidean and hyperbolic spaces. The results obtained are consistent with those for the vortex filament equation, an equivalent form of the Schrödinger map equation in the Euclidean space, and thus, provide a novel extension to its usefulness as a pseudorandom number generator.

arxiv-2405-17753.title: Regression Equilibrium in Electricity Markets
arxiv-2405-17753.creator: Vladimir Dvorkin
arxiv-2405-17753.description: Abstract In two-stage electricity markets, renewable power producers enter the day-ahead market with a forecast of future power generation and then reconcile any forecast deviation in the real-time market at a penalty. The choice of the forecast model is thus an important strategy decision for renewable power producers as it affects financial performance.

arxiv-2410-03783.title: Improving Neural Optimal Transport via Displacement Interpolation
arxiv-2410-03783.creator: Jaemoo Choi, Yongxin Chen, Jaewoong Choi
arxiv-2410-03783.description: Abstract Optimal Transport (OT) theory investigates the cost-minimizing transport map that moves a source distribution to a target distribution. Recently, several approaches have emerged for learning the optimal transport map for a given cost function using neural networks. We refer to these approaches as the OT Map.

arxiv-2509-25560.title: Lightweight and Robust Federated Data Valuation
arxiv-2509-25560.creator: Guojun Tang, Jiayu Zhou, Mohammad Mamun, Steve Drew
arxiv-2509-25560.description: Abstract Federated learning (FL) faces persistent robustness challenges due to non-IID data distributions and adversarial client behavior. A promising mitigation strategy is contribution evaluation, which enables adaptive aggregation by quantifying each client’s utility to the global model. However, state-of-the-art Shapley-value-based approaches incur high computational overhead due to repeated model reweighting and inference, which limits their scalability.

arxiv-2510-08152.title: DACIP-RC: Domain Adaptive Continual Instruction Pre-Training via Reading Comprehension on Business Conversations
arxiv-2510-08152.creator: Elena Khasanova, Harsh Saini, Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar, Xue-Yong Fu Cheng Chen , Shashi Bhushan TN Dialpad Inc. {xue-yong,elena.khasanova,tahmid.rahman,hsaini,cchen,sbhushan}@dialpad.com
arxiv-2510-08152.description: Abstract The rapid advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled their adoption in real-world industrial scenarios for various natural language processing tasks. However, the high inference cost of large-scale LLMs makes their deployment impractical, necessitating the use of smaller models.

pmc-10635329.title: Medicare Data Linkages for Conducting Patient-Centered Outcomes Research on Economic Outcomes
pmc-10635329.creator: Derek S. Brown, Mithuna Srinivasan, Courtney Zott, Kala Wilson, Prashila Dullabh, Scott R. Smith
pmc-10635329.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background:Medicare patients and other stakeholders often make health care decisions that have economic consequences. Research on economic variables that patients have identified as important is referred to as patient-centered outcomes research (PCOR) and can generate evidence that informs decision-making.

pmc-10745044.title: Patients with Hepatitis C Undergoing Direct-Acting Antiviral Treatment Have a Lower SARS-CoV-2 Infection Rate
pmc-10745044.creator: Chin-Wen Hsu, Wan-Wen Yang, Chia-Yi Hou, I-Jung Feng, Ting-Yi Huang, Pei-Lun Lee, How-Ran Guo, Chien-Yuan Huang, Shih-Bin Su
pmc-10745044.description: This study retrospectively analyzed the medical records of 602 patients with first-time positive results for the HCV nucleic acid test between 1 May 2021 and 31 March 2023, exploring the association between DAA treatment and SARS-CoV-2 infection. The results showed that 9.8% of HCV patients were co-infected with SARS-CoV-2.

pmc-12427469.title: Targeting the Tumor Immune Microenvironment in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: The Promise of Polyphenols
pmc-12427469.creator: Aaron L. Hilliard, Tanya D. Russell, Patricia Mendonca, Karam F. A. Soliman
pmc-12427469.description: Simple SummaryTriple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive form of breast cancer that lacks targeted treatment options and disproportionately affects African American women. The tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) plays a key role in promoting tumor growth, immune evasion, and therapy resistance.

pmc-12514644.title: Cortical functional and structural alterations in rhegmatogenous retinal detachment: a multimodal analysis using surface-based independent component analysis, morphometry, and machine learning
pmc-12514644.creator: Yu Ji, Zhuo-Er Dong, Yi-Chong Duan, Li-Li Yao, Xiao-Rong Wu
pmc-12514644.description: BackgroundAlthough previous research has identified functional abnormalities in visual pathways and gray matter areas linked to visual processing in patients with rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (RRD), the precise nature and extent of cortical functional and structural disruptions in these individuals remain insufficiently explored. This study aimed to characterize cortical changes in RRD and investigate their utility as neuroimaging markers.

pmc-12971278.title: A Standardized Culture Medium for Comparative Drug Efficacy Evaluation Across Plasmodium and Babesia Species
pmc-12971278.creator: Pratap Vydyam, Choukri Ben Mamoun
pmc-12971278.description: The discovery of broad-spectrum antiparasitic agents relies on the ability to evaluate drug efficacy under harmonized in vitro conditions across related species. However, current drug screening pipelines for intraerythrocytic parasites are constrained by the use of species-specific media with distinct nutrient compositions and serum sources, which hinder direct comparison of compound potency.

pmc-13092349.title: Type III CD38 is present in the membrane of neurosecretory vesicles and has a cytosol‐facing catalytic domain in primate oxytocin neurons
pmc-13092349.creator: Tatsuki Miyamoto, Akari Matsushima, Akito Otubo, Chihong Song, Kazuyoshi Murata, Takumi Oti, Hirotaka Sakamoto
pmc-13092349.description: CD38, an ADP‐ribosyl cyclase that generates cyclic ADP‐ribose (cADPR), is essential for Ca2+‐dependent oxytocin release. However, its subcellular localisation and membrane topology within oxytocin neurones have remained unclear. We investigated the distribution and orientation of CD38 in oxytocin‐producing neurones of Japanese macaques (Macaca fuscata) using immunoelectron microscopy combined with biochemical isolation of neurosecretory vesicles (NSVs).

pmc-13119431.title: A Nanoliposome Platform Co-Delivery of Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate and Carnosine for Enhanced Epidermal/Dermal Delivery and Multi-Functional Anti-Aging Efficacy
pmc-13119431.creator: Siyuan Chen, Lihao Gu, Ruili Zhao, Lihua Zhang, Lina Yao, Jingning Shen, Dan Luo, Xi Wang, Dan Chen, Si Zhao, Hong Zhou, Wei Liu
pmc-13119431.description: Background: Effective anti-aging requires dual strategies to stimulate regeneration and counteract damage. While the combination of hydroxypinacolone retinoate (HPR) and carnosine (CA) holds great promise, their effectiveness is hampered by instability and poor skin penetration. Methods: To overcome these challenges, this study developed HPR and CA co-encapsulated nanoliposomes (HC-NLPs) via high-pressure homogenization as an advanced epidermal/dermal delivery system.

pmc-13145522.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A794 DIFFERENTIAL PROGNOSTIC VALUE OF CIRCULATING BIOMARKERS ACROSS SMALL ISCHEMIC STROKE SUBTYPES
pmc-13145522.creator: Dario Ramis, Salvatore Rudilosso, Andres Girona, Ona Brengaret, Irene Rosa Batlle, Andrea Cabero-Arnold, Martha Vargas, Inés Bartolomé, Antonio Doncel-Moriano, Alejandro Rodríguez Vázquez, Arturo Renú, Laura Llull, Xabier Urra, Sergio Amaro, Angel Chamorro
pmc-13145522.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and aimsCirculating biomarkers reflecting inflammation and endothelial dysfunction have been proposed as indicators of cerebral small vessel disease. Still, their relevance during the hyperacute phase of ischemic stroke, not only in small vessel disease, remains uncertain.

pmc-13157565.title: Return to Sport and Functional Outcomes After Minimally Invasive Zadek Osteotomy for Insertional Achilles Tendinopathy in Young Athletes: A Retrospective Case Series
pmc-13157565.creator: Gil Genuth, Peter Stavrou, Chris Brown, Lukas D. Iselin
pmc-13157565.description: Background:Insertional Achilles tendinopathy (IAT) is a common cause of posterior heel pain in active individuals and athletes. Traditional open surgical techniques are effective but associated with notable morbidity and prolonged rehabilitation. Minimally invasive Zadek osteotomy (MIS Zadek) has emerged as a tendon-preserving alternative aimed at reducing soft tissue disruption and facilitating early recovery.

pmc-13222559.title: Monocyte/Macrophage Subsets in the Peripheral Blood, Their Related Cytokines, and Circulating Markers of Fibrosis in Active Takayasu Arteritis and Longitudinal Changes Following Immunosuppressive Therapy
pmc-13222559.creator: Tooba Qamar, Deeksha Singh, Ranjeet Singh Chauhan, Sara Abid, Upendra Rathore, Able Lawrence, Manas Ranjan Behera, Neeraj Jain, Manish Ora, Durga Prasanna Misra
pmc-13222559.description: PurposeTakayasu arteritis (TAK) is a rare, stenosing large vessel vasculitis characterised by arterial wall fibrosis. Longitudinal changes in circulating monocyte/macrophage populations, which drive both inflammation and fibrosis in TAK, have not been studied.Patients and MethodsCirculating monocyte/macrophage populations, related cytokines, and markers of fibrosis were evaluated longitudinally in active TAK and compared with healthy controls.

pmc-13229312.title: The revised three-step detour pathway in dolichol biosynthesis is evolutionarily conserved in budding yeast
pmc-13229312.creator: Kazuki Hanaoka, Kuya Matsunaga, Souichirou Shimizu, Soshi Sakai, Harald Pichler, Kouichi Funato
pmc-13229312.description: The identification of SRD5A3, a causative gene for congenital disorders of glycosylation (CDGs), together with its yeast ortholog DFG10, established the prevailing model that dolichol is synthesized from polyprenol in a single step. Subsequently, a recent discovery of DHRSX in CDG patients revised this view and led to the proposal of a three-step detour pathway for dolichol biosynthesis.

pmc-13301748.title: Pleiotropic effects of SCN5A variants: linking electrical dysfunction to structural cardiomyopathy, insights from a single-center case series
pmc-13301748.creator: F Malefora, E Onori, I Concetti, M Apicella, F Schiavone, V Onofri, Y Valeri, F Campanelli, L Finori, G Giacomini, L D'angelo, A Dello Russo, R Grandin, G Tortora, M Casella
pmc-13301748.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe SCN5A gene encodes the α-subunit of the cardiac sodium channel Nav1.5, which is responsible for the rapid depolarization phase of the cardiomyocyte action potential. Pathogenic variants can alter channel function, leading to cardiac channelopathies.

pmc-13435672.title: Characteristics and Outcomes of Rapid Response System Activations in Obstetric Patients: A Multicenter Registry-Based Study in Japan
pmc-13435672.creator: Toshihiro Nakai, Tetsuya Tamura, Tatsuya Tsuji, Toshiyuki Nakanishi, Yuji Kamimura, Yoshiki Sento, Motoshi Tanaka, Kazuya Sobue
pmc-13435672.description: ObjectiveMaternal clinical deterioration during the perinatal period remains a major safety concern. Rapid response systems (RRSs) facilitate early recognition and intervention for clinical deterioration; however, evidence regarding obstetric RRS activations is limited. This study examined the characteristics and outcomes of obstetric RRS activations using a multicenter registry in Japan.

pmc-13540077.title: A mixed-methods feasibility study of dog-assisted exercise therapy in geriatric inpatients
pmc-13540077.creator: Lilly Joschko, Eva Jansen, Stefanie Weinert, Maximilian Hinse, Roland Zerm, Harald Matthes
pmc-13540077.description: BackgroundAnimal-assisted therapy (AAT) is a promising complementary approach in geriatric rehabilitation, but evidence on feasibility and patient experiences remains limited.MethodsThis exploratory, mixed-methods, two-arm randomized controlled parallel-group design (RCT) compared dog-assisted exercise therapy (intervention) to standard exercise therapy (active control) in geriatric inpatients during a two-week rehabilitation program.

pmc-13613469.title: Directional Dependence of Gas Dispersion in Carbonates and Sandstones
pmc-13613469.creator: Tri Pham, Rouhi Farajzadeh, Quoc P. Nguyen
pmc-13613469.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study investigates the directional dependence of gas dispersion in porous media with varying lithology and macroscopic heterogeneity. Eight rock samples, including three carbonates and five sandstones, were examined through CH4–CO2 core-flooding experiments at 300 psi and 65 °C. Each core was first flooded with CO2 displacing CH4, then the core was inverted 180° to quantify the dispersion coefficient in both core orientations. Across most samples, gas dispersion showed directional dependence, with fitted KL values differing by up to 60%.

pmc-13678721.title: RXNMapper-v2: updated validation and evaluation on expanded chemical space
pmc-13678721.creator: Yves Grandjean, Sacha Raffaud, Annie M. Westerlund, Philippe Schwaller, Samuel Genheden, Jean-Louis Reymond
pmc-13678721.description: Atom-to-atom mapping (AAM) assigns reactant atoms to product atoms and is fundamental for reaction classification, template extraction, and synthesis planning. RXNMapper derives AAM from the attention weights of a transformer model trained by masked language modeling on unmapped reaction SMILES. However, its original model selection relied on USPTO-50K, a validation set later shown to contain erroneous mappings.
